messages.subject: Employment law update seminar — 3 February (CPD)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

A reminder that the quarterly Employment team CPD seminar is on 3 February at 12:30 in the Bishopsgate training room (lunch provided). Topics: the new duty to prevent sexual harassment, recent EAT decisions on protected disclosures, and a refresher on settlement agreement drafting. Please RSVP to me by 30 January.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant
